Disclaimer: 🤖 Code and most of this PR description were generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code). I (Benoît, the human) have reviewed the code and it looks good to me, but I don't want to break anything so please take a look (it's a small diff)!

## Summary

I want to build a transport matrix by computing the tendencies from all terms, including those that are usually treated implicitly, so I tried `IsopycnalSkewSymmetricDiffusivity` with `ExplicitTimeDiscretization`, but it errored. The closure naturally defaults to `VerticallyImplicitTimeDiscretization`, so the explicit path was never exercised. 

I know I may be the only one finding a use for an explicit formulation, but this surfaced three latent bugs (as soon as `ExplicitTimeDiscretization()` is passed), which I think does not hurt to fix (and helps me). A minimal model errors at construction, then (once that is fixed) at the first `time_step!`, then again inside `diffusive_flux_z`.

### The three bugs (all in [`isopycnal_skew_symmetric_diffusivity.jl`](https://github.com/CliMA/Oceananigans.jl/blob/main/src/TurbulenceClosures/turbulence_closure_implementations/isopycnal_skew_symmetric_diffusivity.jl))

1. `build_closure_fields` returned `NamedFieldTuple()` but an empty instance is unconstructable (`MethodError`). Replaced with `NamedTuple()`.

2. `compute_closure_fields!` unconditionally launched `compute_tapered_R₃₃!`, writing `closure_fields.ϵ_R₃₃`, but that field that only exists in the implicit case. Now conditional on `VerticallyImplicitTimeDiscretization` (mirrors the triad variant).

3. `explicit_κ_∂z_c` for `ExplicitTimeDiscretization` omitted the tracer argument `c` even though it references `c` in its body (the implicit method swallows it via `args...`). Added `c` to the signature.

With these fixes, the vertical `R₃₃` term is included in the explicit tracer tendency `Gⁿ` (via `explicit_κ_∂z_c` in `diffusive_flux_z`), instead of being folded into the implicit vertical solve and omitted from `Gⁿ`. None of the changes affect the default vertically-implicit path AFAICT.

## Test (updated)

Adds an `IsopycnalSkewSymmetricDiffusivity` regression testset to `test/test_turbulence_closures.jl`, which constructs and time-steps the closure across both time discretizations and both skew-flux formulations. Verified passing locally for `CPU` × {`Float64`, `Float32`} (8/8).
title: Fix IsopycnalSkewSymmetricDiffusivity with ExplicitTimeDiscretization
